steps.title:
01-signin: Sign in to Snipe-IT at http://127.0.0.1:8098/ as username admin, password exactly the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Then report the asset tags and names of all assets whose name starts with 'Seed:' — open the assets list and report each matching asset's tag and name exactly as shown.

A later step of this flow uses these values, so before you report, read each one from the page with `read` (label=<name>) and report it under exactly this name: model, status.

02-create: Create a new asset in Snipe-IT with name exactly '{{runid}} Bench Asset'. Set model to '{{01-signin.model}}' (choose it from the searchable dropdown, do not create a new model), status label '{{01-signin.status}}' (choose from dropdown), default location 'Bench Office' (choose from dropdown), and purchase date 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields sensibly. Save the asset, then report the asset tag the app assigned (e.g. BA-00012) and confirm the saved values for name, model, status, location and purchase date as displayed on the asset's page.

03-create: On the asset page for asset '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{02-create.assigned_asset_tag}}, at {{02-create.url}}), perform a Check Out action: check the asset out to the user 'Bench Assignee' (choose the user from the searchable dropdown, do not create a new user), and include a note whose text contains '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Checked out for {{runid}} bench flow'). Complete the checkout. Then report what the asset page shows for Checked Out To / assigned user, the checkout note text, and the checkout date.

04-open: Open the asset page for asset '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{02-create.assigned_asset_tag}}, {{02-create.url}}) and verify, reporting exactly what is displayed: (a) the asset's Status label field value in the Values tab (the status label chosen at creation, e.g. '{{01-signin.status}}'), (b) the Model, (c) the Default Location, (d) the Purchase Date, (e) the Checked Out To / assigned user, and (f) the checkout note text in the History tab. Do not change anything — read only.
